summary: Give the morning to one hall: Thien Mu above the Perfume River, Ba Chua Xu at the foot of Sam Mountain, or Linh Phuoc’s mosaic court in Da Lat.
body: Thien Mu is the seven-tiered Phước Duyên tower at Hà Khê, on the north bank upstream of the Hue citadel. Ba Chua Xu is the hall at the foot of Núi Sam, in Châu Đốc, and the festival runs in the fourth lunar month. Tay An and the Cave Pagoda sit on the same hill. Hai Tang is the walk up from Bai Lang on the Cham Islands, facing the terraces called Đồng Chùa.

Linh Phuoc is the mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, often paired with the tourist train. Truc Lam is the Zen monastery above Tuyen Lam. Minh Thanh overlooks Pleiku. Vietnam Tourism notes it was built in 1964, with a 72 m gold-painted tower. In Hanoi, the Temple of Literature is the Confucian temple and the first national university, west of the old commercial streets. Ngoc Son Temple sits on its island in Hoan Kiem.
